name: memory.long_term.save
description: Save a long-term memory that should persist across conversations and workspaces. Use this tool ONLY when the user has explicitly asked you to remember something (e.g., 'save this to memory', 'remember that...', 'note this for later'). Do NOT call this tool to spontaneously save things you judge important during normal conversation — the system handles that automatically via a post-turn extraction pass. Importance is 1-10; reserve 9-10 for hard user identity / preferences.
